title: The 13 Best Coffee Makers for One Person
h1: The 13 Best Coffee Makers for One Person
metaDescription: Our 13 picks for coffee makers for one person, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at coffee makers for one person using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Keurig K-Elite Single Serve Coffee Maker
products.blurb: Key specs: Temperature control across a 187 to 192 degree range, Strong brew setting for bolder K-Cup extraction, Built-in iced coffee mode.
strengths: 30-second brew time with zero grinding, measuring, or cleanup
Strong brew setting genuinely improves K-Cup coffee, which is under-extracted by default
Temperature control lets hotter-preference drinkers dial past the default 187 degrees
limitations: Coffee quality is capped by pod freshness, no amount of temperature tuning fixes stale grounds
Large reservoir and footprint compared to true single-cup manual methods
features: Temperature control across a 187 to 192 degree range
Strong brew setting for bolder K-Cup extraction

products.name: Nespresso Essenza Mini Original Espresso Machine by Breville
products.blurb: Key specs: 19-bar pump pressure for true crema, 25-second heat-up time, Compact footprint under 5 inches wide.
strengths: Produces genuine espresso-style crema that K-Cup machines cannot replicate
25-second brew is faster than the Keurig's heat-up cycle
One of the smallest machines in this list, fits on the narrowest counters
Nitrogen-sealed pods stay fresher than K-Cups over long storage
limitations: Optimized for 40 to 80ml shots, not standard 8-ounce drip-style cups
No milk frother included on the Mini, so lattes require a separate device

products.name: AeroPress Original XL Coffee Press
products.blurb: Key specs: Air-pressure immersion brewing, 1 to 2 minute total brew time, Brews directly into a mug or travel cup.
strengths: Produces a clean, low-acid cup with no bitterness even at high extraction
Plunger sweeps the chamber clean, making cleanup faster than any drip machine
Compact enough to pack in a travel bag, works anywhere boiling water is available
limitations: Requires manual technique: timing, grind size, and water temperature all matter
Produces only one to two cups per session, not suited for entertaining
Needs a separate kettle since it has no heating element
Learning curve means the first few cups are inconsistent
features: Brews directly into a mug or travel cup
No electricity or heating element required
Plunger self-cleans the chamber after each use

products.name: Bonavita BV1901TS 8-Cup One-Touch Coffee Brewer
products.blurb: Key specs: SCA-certified brew temperature of 198 to 205 degrees, Pre-infusion bloom mode, 8-cup capacity sized correctly for 1 to 2 people.
strengths: Only SCA-certified machine at this price point, correctly extracting flavor from good beans
Bloom pre-infusion wets grounds evenly before full extraction, a step budget machines skip
8-cup basket size is properly proportioned for 1 to 2 cup brews, unlike 12-cup machines
Thermal carafe keeps coffee hot without the burnt taste a hot plate produces
limitations: No programmable timer, must be started manually each time
Plain, utilitarian design with no digital display
Narrow carafe opening is harder to clean than a wide-mouth design
features: SCA-certified brew temperature of 198 to 205 degrees
8-cup capacity sized correctly for 1 to 2 people
One-touch operation with no programming needed

products.name: Kalita Wave Pour-Over Coffee Dripper 185
products.blurb: Key specs: Flat-bottom design with three small holes, Wave-shaped filter for consistent flow, Brews 1 to 2 cups per session.
strengths: Flat-bottom geometry produces more even extraction than cone-shaped drippers
Wave filter's consistent flow rate is more forgiving of pour technique than the Hario V60
Stainless build survives drops that would crack a ceramic dripper
limitations: Requires a gooseneck kettle for the slow, controlled pour the method depends on
Proprietary wave filters cost more per filter than standard cone filters
No thermal retention, coffee cools quickly once brewed
features: Flat-bottom design with three small holes
No electricity, works with any kettle

products.name: Keurig K-Compact Single Serve Coffee Maker
products.blurb: Key specs: 3 cup sizes: 8, 10, and 12 ounces, Compact 5-inch-wide footprint, Removable 36-ounce reservoir.
strengths: 5-inch width is the smallest footprint of any single-serve machine in this guide
Simple one-button operation with no settings to configure
limitations: No temperature control or strong brew setting, unlike the K-Elite
Only 3 cup sizes versus 5 on the pricier K-Elite

products.name: Cuisinart SS-15W Coffee Center 12-Cup and Single-Serve Brewer
products.blurb: Key specs: 12-cup carafe side plus K-Cup-compatible single-serve side, Independent brewing on each side, Adjustable single-serve cup sizes.
strengths: Genuinely useful for one person living with others who drink a full pot
Single-serve side works with any K-Cup and includes a reusable filter for ground coffee
Two independent brewing systems mean no waiting for one to finish before using the other
Programmable timer on the carafe side handles the household's morning routine automatically
limitations: Largest footprint in this guide by a wide margin, needs real counter space
Two brewing systems means two things that can eventually need repair
Single-serve side lacks the temperature and strength controls of a dedicated Keurig
features: 12-cup carafe side plus K-Cup-compatible single-serve side
Hot water on demand for tea or instant items
Programmable 24-hour timer on the carafe side

products.name: Primula Burke Deluxe Cold Brew Coffee Maker 1.6-Qt
products.blurb: Key specs: 1.6-quart capacity, roughly 6 servings of concentrate, Removable fine-mesh stainless steel filter, Airtight lid for refrigerator storage.
strengths: One batch yields nearly a week of concentrate for a solo drinker
Fine-mesh filter eliminates sediment better than cheesecloth-based methods
Airtight lid means the same carafe steeps and stores in the fridge
Cold brew concentrate lasts up to 2 weeks refrigerated, longer than hot-brewed coffee
limitations: Requires 12 to 24 hours of lead time, not a same-morning solution
Plastic carafe feels less premium than glass alternatives at a similar price
Concentrate must be diluted, adding an extra step versus ready-to-drink coffee

products.name: Hario V60 Ceramic Pour-Over Coffee Dripper
products.blurb: Key specs: Spiral ridges inside the cone for airflow, Large single hole for pour-rate control, Ceramic construction retains heat better than plastic.
strengths: Spiral ridges create an air channel that improves extraction consistency versus flat-walled drippers
Ceramic body holds heat noticeably better than the plastic version, keeping brew temperature stable
Large single hole gives skilled pourers precise control over flow rate and extraction time
limitations: Steepest learning curve of any method here, technique-sensitive results
Ceramic is fragile and will crack if dropped on a hard floor
Requires a gooseneck kettle to get consistent results
features: Spiral ridges inside the cone for airflow
Large single hole for pour-rate control
Ceramic construction retains heat better than plastic
Cone-shaped design accepts standard V60 filters
Brews 1 to 4 cups depending on size

products.name: COSORI Electric Gooseneck Pour-Over Kettle 0.8L
products.blurb: Key specs: Precision gooseneck spout for controlled pouring, 5 temperature presets from 135 to 212 degrees, 0.8-liter capacity.
strengths: Gooseneck spout gives the slow, controlled pour that Kalita Wave and Hario V60 brewing require
Temperature presets remove the guesswork of using a stovetop kettle with no gauge
1200 watts brings 0.8 liters to a boil in under 5 minutes
limitations: 0.8-liter capacity means reheating if brewing for more than 2 to 3 cups
An added purchase on top of whichever dripper it pairs with
Keep-warm function draws standby power if left on for the full hour
features: Precision gooseneck spout for controlled pouring

products.name: Keurig K-Mini Single Serve Coffee Maker
strengths: Very narrow footprint
Brews any size from 6 to 12 oz
Fits travel mugs up to 7 inches
Auto-off after brewing
limitations: Single cup reservoir; refill each time
Pod costs add up
Coffee strength is modest

products.name: Nespresso Vertuo Pop+ Coffee and Espresso Maker by Breville
strengths: Espresso and coffee from one machine
One-touch operation
Compact design
Fast heat-up
limitations: Only works with Vertuo pods
Pods cost more than ground coffee
No milk frother included in base model

products.name: Keurig K-Express Single Serve Coffee Maker
strengths: Brews 8, 10 or 12 oz cups
Strong button for bolder coffee
42 oz reservoir means fewer refills
Simple, affordable entry to K-Cups
limitations: Pod costs add up over time
No temperature or iced settings
Plastic build

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
